verdict.description: Does the page support the claim?

x-criteria.supports: The page states what the claim says.
x-criteria.partly: The page supports part of the claim; the rest is not on the page.
x-criteria.not_supported: The page does not say what the claim says, and does not say the opposite.
x-criteria.contradicts: The page says the opposite of the claim, or gives different figures.
x-criteria.unreadable: The page has no usable text: a paywall, a cookie wall or an empty shell.

supports.description: Does the page support everything the claim says?

x-criteria.true: Every part of the claim is stated on the page.
x-criteria.false: Some part of the claim is missing from the page or contradicted by it.

probabilities.description: How likely each answer is, from 0 to 1.

verdict.description: The probability of each verdict. They sum to 1.

supports.description: The probability that the page supports everything the claim says.
